regime_context: Detector shows a one-narrative, narrow tape: only Banks and Coal are trend-gate eligible (2 of 22 themes), with Banks dominant and crowded (1.84 z, breadth 1.0). Backtest verdict is explicit: the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history and rank-IC is ~0, so this is a discipline/display read, not an edge. Given gate_helps=false and dir_accuracy 0.377 on 77 graded calls, all convictions default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal (cn_coal) converts from mean-revert to a trend hurst_tag with breadth recovering above 0.7 and durability crossing 0.6 — that would mark a genuine confirmed leadership handoff challenge to Banks, retiring the watch. Until then this is Banks-only leadership.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the single eligible leader with full breadth (1.0), high durability (0.8) and a trend hurst_tag, meaning the cleanest trend structure on the board. Crowding (1.84 z, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, never a fade per guardrails. The lean is a passive trend-following tilt conditioned on the trend gate remaining intact.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.228, only theme with breadth 1.0
rotation.leader = cn_banks with margin 0.263 over challenger Coal
gate_helps=false, so this is display/experimental — conviction capped low
theses.dissent: Crowding z 1.84 marks this as a late, reflexive move — attention spikes in thematic proxies historically mark tops, and the equal-weight 'Financials & Value' cluster has no breadth support outside Banks itself.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS prints a 15% drawdown from any 5-day high inside 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme, but its hurst_tag reads 'mean-revert' against a 0.5 durability bar, and breadth is just 0.4. Under trend-following discipline, mean-reverting leaders are exactly the shake-out candidates the (weak-on-this-market) gate is meant to screen out.
evidence: crowding_z 0.68 — not crowded, so no reflexive support for the trend
theses.dissent: Coal is a genuine challenger with the second-highest score and no crowding; if Banks corrects, mean-revert leadership can still grind higher short-term.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS closes above a rolling 30-day high with breadth recovering above 0.7 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute is rank 5 with breadth 0.0 and not trend-gate eligible, plus a crowded-adjacent -0.72 crowding z (no reflexive support). In a one-narrative tape where only Banks and Coal qualify, everything else is structural laggard territory until the gate confirms otherwise.
evidence: one_narrative=true, absorption 0.33 — capital is concentrated in the leader, not spread to tech
theses.dissent: The macro tape shows 'ai_tech' among dominant market-level themes (n=2), and a sharp narrative switch would hit non-eligible names first while the gate lags.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS closes above its own 60-day high while the trend gate marks it eligible inside 20 trading days.
